title: I Took the Neighbor's Pressure-Washer Hours to the City Quiet Ordinance

parts.text: I asked for Sundays off. They pressure-washed the driveway at 7:04 a.m. anyway. The city quiet ordinance they had quoted at me about my music said: POWER TOOLS AFTER 9 ON SUNDAY. I was forty, shift sleeper, holding their printed quote. I recorded 11 minutes, attached their quote, and filed the city form they had shown me. A letter went to their door. Sundays got quiet at 7. They wash at 9:05 now, loudly, legally. I sleep like a person who can read.

social.video_title: They quoted the ordinance and washed at 7:04 — Part 1/1
social.description: Sunday shift sleep, a driveway roar, their own quote. The city sent a letter. Would you have worn earplugs forever?
